notes.title: Startup Bug Successfully Resolved!
notes.notes:
Dear Players,

We would like to extend our sincerest apologies for a recent incident. During a past update, an operational error led to the incorrect upload of the MAC version to the Windows branch. As a result, Windows users experienced difficulties in launching the game post-update.

[b]We have since rectified this error, ensuring the correct game package has been uploaded. Following thorough testing, we can confidently state that the game is now downloadable and operational for Windows users.[/b]

We deeply regret any inconvenience caused and appreciate your understanding. 

Thank you every!

notes.title: Japanese Voice and Mac Version is Updated!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

[b]"Room of Depression" is now available in 6 languages! Thank you very much to all players and localization workers for your support.[/b]

Japanese voice acting has been added to the game in an update. Everyone is welcome to experience it! (You should choose Japanese language to have Japanese voice acting, but we are scheudled a update to separate language and voice acting.)

As for the previous feedback from some players about whether it can be played on Mac, after a period of research, we update the game so that it can be run stably on Mac systems. I sincerely hope that anyone who are using any device can have a chance to experience this game, and learn about depression.

However, we also encountered some problems. Our original intention in making this game was to make more people aware of depression, so we sold it at a low price. As a result, we have no resources in the past six months to promote it and update languages ​​in regions with high depression rates (such as South Korea and Northern Europe). 

[h3]Therefore, [b]we have decided to adjust the sale price to 5.99 USD after February 3[/b], in order to let players in more regions to understand depression through the game.[/h3]

I also encourage everyone who loves this game to share the game to person you know. Let more people can have the opportunity to understand depression.

Thanks for your support,
I hope that more people can understand depression, pay attention to and help patients with depression,
This is what I strive to achieve.
Thank you so much!

notes.title: Result of "Participating in Charity Fundraising"
notes.notes:
Hello, fellow gamers!

Greetings to all of you! It has been some time since we last announced our donation plan, and now it's time for us to fulfill our promise.

Based on the revenue report provided by the official STEAM platform and considering the current exchange rates, 5% of the actual income for the first month of sales amounts to $233.

As agreed, the charitable project we intended to support had surpassed its fundraising duration. Therefore, we have decided to redirect our donation to the International Red Cross through their donation portal. The screenshot below shows our contribution:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42732691/e3b9da6a520c96042db36ebc454b9bab693d4a60.png[/img]

We understand that our contribution might be modest, but we hope it can ignite a spark of hope in more people. Life's journey is long, and together, let us encourage each other to move forward!

notes.title: Updates on Donation Campaign & Thank You
notes.notes:
Hello, fellow players!

Since the release of our game, we have received a lot of feedback and seen many people sharing their stories. It has deeply moved us.
Everyone is carrying their own burdens while moving forward, and if you ever find yourself lost, we hope you can find the light at the end of the tunnel.

Now, without us realizing it, it has already been a month since the release, do you remember our promise? We pledged to donate 5% of the total game revenue to a charity. We know it's not a significant amount, but it is our desire to contribute what we can to the field of mental health.

Due to STEAM's backend rules, the income from May will be settled and reported by the end of June, and we will calculate the amount by early July.
At that time, as promised, we will donate the funds to Tencent Charity's Smile Initiative for Depression Prevention and Support ( [url=https://gongyi.qq.com/succor/detail.htm?id=3004798]腾讯公益的微笑抑郁者守望行动[/url](click here to view)). Please trust us, and thank you for each and every one of your support!

[b]Additionally, we would like to express our gratitude to the players who have provided translations in other languages. Your actions have given this game even more meaning.[/b]

notes.title: "Room of Depression" is now released
notes.notes:
Hello everyone~
After a year of hard work, "Room of Depression" finally ushered in the day it goes online, and it's a day worth celebrating!

It is priced as $3.99 with a 10% off in the first week.

"Room of Depression" is a narrative ADV game that is not long. It pays more attention to "feeling" rather than the story itself. Experience the inner ups and downs of the protagonist Moon as a patient with depression.

I hope that players can get a little touch or encouragement in the game, and I also hope that people might pay more attention to people with depression.

As for the [i]Donation[/i], it's been explained at [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/2056340/announcements/detail/3683425195452296740]the last anouncement[/url]. I will donate 5% of my gross income to a charity fundraiser focused on depression. There are a huge number of depressed people in this world, and this is only a modest contribution I can make.

I wish you would like it and have fun playing.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2056340/_/

notes.title: Fixed the mouse sensitivity problem and modified the game process
notes.notes:
After participating in the Next Fest, we received a lot of feedback. Among them, the most affecting player is that the mouse sensitivity is too high, which makes the player feel irritable when playing, which prevents the player from being immersed in the protagonist's state of mind. We have spent a lot of effort trying to fix it, if players still encounter problems, please email to firepillar2@gmail.com or go to the official Discord group https://discord.gg/waTH89hUsY to let us know.

In addition, we have also modified the game flow to improve the player's experience.

notes.title: "Room of Depression" released a demo, lead player to experience depression
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=Qena0Kd7qZg;full][/previewyoutube]

"Room of Depression" is an adventure game on Steam that focuses on the atmosphere and experience of depression. Depression is a common mental illness around the world, especially in developed cities. This game leads players to have a taste of depression themselves through the game experience.

Same encounter, different world
Moon is a young woman who lives an ordinary city life as an office worker. However, because she suffers from depression, she reacts and deals with things in a way that is very different from regular city folk.

Players can click the link below to get the demo version of "Room of Depression":
[url=]https://store.steampowered.com/app/2056340/[/url]
